scDown::run_clusterProfiler - Perform pathway enrichment analysis (KEGG, GO_BP, GO_CC, GO_MF) between conditions.

  • 1 Run clusterProfiler
  • 2 Test Results Figures
    • 2.1 GO_BP on all significant DE genes (Barplot, using top terms by p.adjust)
    • 2.2 GO_BP on all significant DE genes (Dotplot, using top terms by p.adjust, then sorted by gene ratio)
    • 2.3 GO_BP on up-regulated DE genes
    • 2.4 GO_CC on all significant DE genes
    • 2.5 GO_MF on all significant DE genes
    • 2.6 KEGG on down-regulated DE genes

1 Run clusterProfiler

Run the test for all the pairwise comparison in group column for all the cell types in annotation column. The figures and statistical results with be saved in the output_dir

# Metadata condition column to perform the comparison
species <- "mouse"
run_clusterProfiler(seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
                    annotation_column = annotation_column,
                    group_column = group_column, 
                    output_dir = output_dir,
                    species = species,
                    n_jobs = 2)

2 Test Results Figures

After running the clusterProfiler test, the following figures will be generated.

2.1 GO_BP on all significant DE genes (Barplot, using top terms by p.adjust)

2.2 GO_BP on all significant DE genes (Dotplot, using top terms by p.adjust, then sorted by gene ratio)

2.3 GO_BP on up-regulated DE genes

2.4 GO_CC on all significant DE genes

2.5 GO_MF on all significant DE genes

2.6 KEGG on down-regulated DE genes

The analysis was performed on a machine with the following specifications:

  • Operating System: Rocky Linux 8.9 (Green Obsidian)
  • Product Name and Version: RHEL
  • Product Version: 8.9
  • CPU: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum 8358 CPU @ 2.60GHz
  • Memory: 10 GB
